name: Fence Climbing
description: Perimeter fencing is a primary physical barrier on many targets. The RTT Folding Fence Climbers are lightweight aids that hook over a chain-link fence and provide a stable foothold for climbing without the grip and balance demands of unassisted climbing. They fold flat for covert carry and are particularly useful for targets where the fence line is the primary perimeter control. Fence line reconnaissance during PRTF-1 directly informs where climbing is most effective.

blue.det: Highly visible — individual with climbing equipment near perimeter; camera footage; neighbor or patrol sighting.
blue.cm: Anti-climb fence toppers (rotating spikes, added height); CCTV coverage of full perimeter; motion-triggered lighting; irregular patrol covering perimeter; vibration sensors on fence line.
